description:
## Goal

Replace both drain-time scans of standing waits with exact edge-triggered work at the moment a completion leaves a new wait unsatisfied.

## Current defect

`World::demand_blocked_wait_producers` materializes the full unresolved-wait inventory whenever the agenda drains, deduplicates facts, and demands their mapped producers. `World::settle_quiescent_waits` separately iterates the standing settled waits at a drain. The exact wait edge was already present in the completion, so both scans rediscover information the engine previously knew.

On the historical pre-cutover 00420 trace, 999 work starts are attributed to BlockedWaiterExpansion. Those starts are legitimate producer pulls unless proven otherwise; the defect is the global rediscovery pass, not the count itself. Sampling shows this path is not the dominant cold-compile cost, so acceptance is structural and causal rather than a wall-clock claim.

## Output contract

- When a completion records a newly unsatisfied FactUse, DependencyIndex registers that exact producer-demand edge. A demand-enabled driver consumes it through `World::demand_fact_producer`; queued-source reconciliation retains it without expanding standing demand.
- The FactKey-to-producer map remains the sole work authority; no job names or enqueues a follow-up job.
- Chained waits expand one newly discovered frontier at a time.
- Multiple waiters for one fact coalesce to one producer demand without a full-table dedup pass.
- An exact settled wait is handed to quiescent arbitration without scanning other waiters.
- A blocked job does not rerun until a waited fact satisfies it.
- Permanently unresolved waits remain available for one terminal diagnostic inventory.
- Deterministic order comes from recorded edge order or canonical data, never Debug formatting.

## TDD

1. Multi-hop blocked chain: exact producer-demand sequence and one frontier per movement.
2. Two jobs waiting on one fact: producer demanded once.
3. One job with current and settled uses of a fact: readiness semantics remain distinct.
4. Permanently unresolved fact: no repeated producer poke or blocked-job rerun; final diagnostic remains complete.
5. Quiescent cyclic settled wait: arbitration wakes the exact waiter and emits the readiness movement.
6. Delete both drain-time standing-wait scans.

## Telemetry acceptance

- Full unresolved and waited-settled scans during normal driving are zero.
- Every BlockedWaiterExpansion names the exact newly recorded FactUse that caused it.
- A completion with no new wait causes no producer demand.
- Terminal diagnostic inventory is distinguishable from scheduling work.
- Work histograms, causal traces, and outputs are deterministic.
- Root scans and unsanctioned work starts remain zero.

## Required deletions

- `demand_blocked_wait_producers` and its unresolved inventory path.
- Normal-drive use of `settle_quiescent_waits` and its standing-wait iteration.
- `stall_demanded` and scan-era duplicate-poke suppression if edge coalescing makes them unnecessary.
- Debug-format ordering and comments that describe a drain scan as demand-driven.
- Temporary frontier queues not owned by the dependency index.

## Product-dependency cutover constraint

fz-tfn.12 makes source consumers read retained products through the same scheduler. While drain-time optimistic arbitration remains, Scheduler::has_unsettled_external_ground follows the candidate fact's exact unquiet publisher/read edges to prevent certifying a fact grounded in an unsettled external product. ProductSessions gates that guard through the exact unresolved observed-address index; no memo values or generations are copied into fact slots.

The edge-triggered cutover must subsume and delete this repeated arbitration-time upstream walk, not preserve it as a new private cone. Finality must follow precise fact/product dependency movement through the existing dependency owner. Preserve the regressions quiescence_cannot_certify_a_fact_while_its_external_ground_is_dirty and an_unrelated_dirty_product_does_not_block_fact_quiescence, plus failed product validation/retry and nested active roots. An unsettled unrelated product must not block a local fact cycle.

## Checks and documentation

Run scheduler, drive, quiescence, unresolved-diagnostic, product-fact-wait, target fixture, full library, single-threaded matrix, and clippy checks. Update fact-engine, pipeline, scheduler documentation, and `northstar.html` with the edge-triggered protocol.

## Current branch resumption

Resume on fz-tfn/long-lived-recalculator after ad0ac47d3 (.24), not on the parked fz-wt-kdt46 worktree. The historical worktree remains untouched; inspect any old experiment read-only and redesign against current World/ProductMemo ownership. All prerequisites are closed. .41 already certifies exact concordant derivation outputs and retains the real unquiet-input count; later movement revokes that certificate. Preserve its mixed old/new dependency ordering tests while replacing drain-time rediscovery and upstream external-ground walks with exact owner-maintained edges. .24 measures actual RuntimeDemand body derivations (distinct from scheduler completions); maintain causal attribution and prove any count differences, not merely rebaseline them. .18 exact rooted contribution packaging and .12 retained macro/product subscriptions are part of this base. Implementation remains TDD with one fresh scoped cold review before one commit/close, and CI-gated push.


## Current implementation strategy and baseline

Output contract: completing a newly unsatisfied wait immediately registers its exact FactUse in the DependencyIndex-owned pending producer frontier; a demand-enabled boundary consumes it through the fact-to-producer map. Unchanged/shared standing waits do not rediscover demand. DependencyIndex owns pending settled arbitration edges, reactivated only by relevant dependency movement. No standing-wait scheduling inventory remains.

External-ground finality is cyclic reachability, not a boolean count: removing the last external entrance must release a local cycle, while another live entrance must keep it blocked. Extract the existing ProductMemo rooted-witness algorithm into a domain-free witness over owner-provided forward/reverse edges, and use it for both retained product membership and exact external grounding. This extraction is atomic with the scheduler cutover: ProductMemo retains its dirty/change authority; DependencyIndex retains read/output authority; witnesses retain support only, not another graph or fact/product values. Preserve quiet-fact propagation cuts, exact derivation certificates, two external sources, alternate entrances, last-source withdrawal, and equal-result readiness restoration. No independent SCC/cone evaluator or repeated arbitration walk.

Baseline on ad0ac47d3: scheduler suite 56/56 passes, /tmp/fz-kdt46-scheduler-baseline.log. Baseline artifact binaries and target measurements remain /tmp/fz-tfn24-after.n6luYj. First RED added: completing_a_new_wait_expands_only_its_exact_producer_frontier; asserts immediate chain expansion, unchanged/shared edge coalescing, exact demand tally, and retained diagnostic inventory.

Historical integration guidepost: the parked candidate stalled Settled(ActivationAnalyzed(Function205)) after the separate root scanner was removed. Preserve the sole activation frontier; identify and repair the exact missing wait/publication edge if reproduced. The prior binder-order prerequisite is closed in .26; typed semantic comparison is authoritative.


## Demand-scope correction established by TDD

The first unconditional-enqueue candidate changed normal agenda interleaving and incorrectly expanded new producer work inside drain_pending_for, whose contract is queued edits plus exact wakes only. Full-library evidence: reconciliation_failure_is_attributed_to_the_failed_retained_request_only failed on its later retry. Root reviewed and approved one scope-aware owner model: DependencyIndex retains exact pending producer edges, coalesced at completion; demand-enabled boundaries consume these edges after pending work, while reconciliation retains them. Delete the unconditional path rather than maintain immediate/deferred modes. Filter withdrawn/satisfied edges without inventory scans; use actual Agenda::enqueue insertion for causal demand counts. Tests must prove deferred edge retention across reconciliation, one later expansion, shared/unchanged coalescing, and withdrawal without work. Initial interleaving candidate metrics are not accepted baselines.


## Parked candidate and failure-ownership prerequisite

The scope-aware candidate removes both standing-wait scheduling scans and arbitration-time upstream external-ground search. DependencyIndex owns exact producer/arbitration edges; reconciliation retains producer edges; normal demand boundaries consume them. Generic RootedWitness is shared with ProductMemo, whose dirty/change authority remains unchanged. External support uses one multi-source witness over exact existing reads/outputs with quiet-fact cuts and exact source attach/revoke; no source-frontier rescan. Shared witness refresh uses indexed membership (wide-fanout comparison test). Local dirty-to-clean publication reoffers its exact settled wait even when revision/finality do not move. Actual Agenda insertion controls producer demand counts and public wait_expanded causes.

TDD evidence: /tmp/fz-kdt46-edge-red.log proves old discovery misses the newly recorded edge; final regression is completing_a_new_wait_records_only_its_exact_producer_frontier. /tmp/fz-kdt46-ground-red.log records 9 upstream state reads across 3 arbitrations, versus zero after maintained support. /tmp/fz-kdt46-clean-red.log proves missing local-clean eligibility. /tmp/fz-kdt46-coalesce-red.log uses CallGraphComponent/Recursive sharing one producer and proves old true-on-coalescing count 2 versus actual1; the actual-enqueue implementation has been restored. No temporary production switch or test-only old-walk oracle remains.

Intermediate green gates: scheduler59/59 (/tmp/fz-kdt46-scheduler-green.log), shared ProductMemo rooted/lifecycle14/14 (/tmp/fz-kdt46-witness-extraction.log). Most recent scope-aware full library /tmp/fz-kdt46-lib-scoped.log:1905 pass,2 fail,6 existing ignored. One failure was an invalid synthetic coalescing setup subsequently corrected; the other is a real failed macro repair issue below. All original target artifact/work pins and reconciliation retry passed again after scope-aware frontier corrected the discarded unconditional-enqueue candidate. Newly added scope/cancellation/quiet-cut/wide-fanout tests need the final rerun after the prerequisite. Matrix, strict clippy, docs/fmt, independent final artifact evidence, and cold review are still outstanding.

The remaining macro regression exposes lost failure dependencies masked by the old unresolved scan. jobs/body.rs::lower_function records FunctionDefined(function) in local reads, but lowerer.lower()? can return FatalError before JobEffects carries those reads to Scheduler; drive Err exits without completing any attempted dependency ownership. A first failing LowerFunction31 therefore retains no FunctionDefined subscription. Its exact LoweredBody demand edge was consumed before failure; source repair creates no new waiter, leaving RootEntry(root3) blocked behind LoweredBody/StaticCallees/InputDemand/Recursive. /tmp/fz-kdt46-macro-waits.log and /tmp/fz-kdt46-macro-ground-oracle.log preserve the evidence; the temporary comparison matched the former external-ground predicate throughout, excluding witness mismatch. The macro test's Capture borrow was narrowed (drop events after diagnostic assertions) so retry diagnostics can be observed instead of panicking RefCell. All original semantic assertions remain; retry must return42, not tolerate another error. Prerequisite fz-tfn.46 owns failed-derivation exact read ownership: unchanged failure must not retry producer work; relevant repair must awaken it through its precise read edge.

Implementation agent released all Cargo/build/fmt ownership; all handles terminal. Candidate source is intentionally parked uncommitted for root to stash selectively, land fz-tfn.46 through its own implementation/cold review/commit, then restore and resume fz-kdt.46. The old /tmp/fz-kdt46-candidate.v91nci binary is the DISCARDED unconditional-interleaving diagnostic candidate, not a final artifact baseline. Final comparisons must use a newly copied corrected binary after the prerequisite. Preserve all unrelated untracked measurements and historical worktrees.


## Recoverable branch boundary
Root selectively stashed exactly the kdt.46-owned 18 tracked and 2 untracked files in commit69e41a8d2cf2681ca65b3b76c0fc29bbe6a666d1 (message: fz-kdt.46 scope-aware edge candidate parked for fz-tfn.46 failure ownership). All unrelated untracked measurements remain in place; working source is clean at ad0ac47d3. Do not drop this stash. Restore by explicit immutable stash commit only after separately reviewed fz-tfn.46 lands, resolve overlaps with its final owner model, and revalidate all kdt.46 gates. Agent implement_tfn46_failure owns the blocker source/build workflow; implement_kdt46_edges is released and available for resumption. Root owns restoration/index/commits/push.


## fz-kdt.214 transition evidence

fz-kdt.214 makes InputDemand depend on retained per-function InputFlow facts. On the three causal-census fixtures, upstream InputFlow settlement can extend an unsettled InputDemand wait before InputDemand itself settles. The current drain-time waiter expansion then reruns SeedRoot(main) without a moved dependency: exactly 3/1/0 pre-settlement evaluations for fz_f98_range_map_converges / enum_predicate_search / enum_take_drop_split. A captured trace shows DeriveInputFlow(function174) settling, two SeedRoot wakes coalescing under the still-unsettled InputDemand(main, revision 1), and SeedRoot evaluating before DeriveInputDemand later settles that same revision and issues the legitimate wake. fz-kdt.214 preserves this narrow transition signal and forbids every other uncaused evaluation; it adds no scheduler shim. This ticket must remove the drain-time expansion and return all three counts to zero, while preserving the later legitimate InputDemand-settled wake.

comments.text: Cold review exposed a general binder-scoped semantic-order prerequisite now owned by fz-tfn.26. Partition the existing uncommitted diff: .26 gets structural addressing/TyCanon/all observable ordering and its proofs; .46 retains only exact wait edges, settlement/arbitration, causal session accounting, and dependent docs/tests. Rebase .46 on the reviewed .26 commit; no mechanism is deferred or dropped.

Current-base integration RED after fz-tfn.5: exact-edge candidate stalls deterministically on Settled(ActivationAnalyzed(FunctionId(205))) because it assumes the deleted separate root frontier. With the sole activation frontier, a blocked first AnalyzeActivation run is retired and no later exact edge re-ignites it. Any diagnostic restoration of the old scanner is probe-only and forbidden from delivery. Correct the missing publication/wait edge after fz-tfn.26; preserve the one-frontier model.

title: Make blocked-wait expansion and settled arbitration edge-triggered
